title: Ethiopian Yeasty Silky Chicken Tagine
description: A rich, comforting, and aromatic chicken stew from Ethiopia, featuring a silky, yeasty texture. Perfect for a cozy dinner with friends or family.

ingredients.name: chicken stock concentrate
ingredients.notes: make sure to use gluten-free stock concentrate if needed

instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and yeast. Add the mixture to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the water to the saucepan, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Add the chicken stock concentrate, chicken breast, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan. Cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and coconut oil. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the tagine with steamed rice or injera bread for a traditional Ethiopian experience.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
